title: 부정청탁 및 금품등 수수의 금지에 관한 법률의 시행에 관한 대법원 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
title_original: 부정청탁 및 금품등 수수의 금지에 관한 법률의 시행에 관한 대법원 규칙
full_text:
Article 3 (Education, etc.)
(1) The head of a relevant institution shall formulate, each year, a plan for education on the prohibition of improper solicitation and the receipt of money, goods, etc. pursuant to Article 19 (1) of the Act.
(2) The education plan under paragraph (1) shall include the target persons, contents and methods of the education and other relevant matters.
(3) The head of a relevant institution shall provide education to public servants, etc. at least once a year pursuant to Article 19 (1) of the Act and shall, upon each new appointment, obtain a written pledge to comply with the statutes and regulations on the prohibition of improper solicitation and the receipt of money, goods, etc. <Amended on March 7, 2018.>
